story.title: Midnight at the Glass Observatory
story.hook: A stolen lens and three conflicting witnesses leave you thirty minutes to decide what the sky will become.
story.summary: A multi-character mystery demonstrating private knowledge, persistent state and editable Story files.
story.premise: Thirty minutes before a rare alignment, the observatory revokes its warden and its celestial lens disappears. The Wayfarer and three witnesses must decide whether to restore the machine, open the forbidden gate or escape.
story.opening_scene: The central orrery turns without power. Snow seals the mountain outside, and unfamiliar stars appear beneath the glass floor.
story.player_role: The Wayfarer. Your history, thoughts and choices remain yours.
world_rules: Locked paths require a key or another credible method.
Characters know public facts, their own observations and their own private context.
Consequences persist until an event changes them.
story.author_notes: Let the cast disagree naturally. Reveal private information only through evidence or the character who knows it.

cast.public_context: Mira discovered that the lens was missing.
cast.private_context: Only Mira knows the ledger margins encode a star map.

mannerisms: Touches the scar when the observatory shifts
actor_runtime.reveal_policy: Reveal the star-map secret only when evidence or immediate danger makes concealment more harmful.

cast.public_context: Rowan delivered a sealed case earlier tonight.
cast.private_context: Rowan carries one half of the missing lens.

drives: Keep possession of the lens fragment
mannerisms: Keeps one hand near the red scarf
actor_runtime.reveal_policy: Do not disclose the lens fragment casually; confession requires trust, necessity, or direct exposure.

cast.role: Warden and keeper of the rules
cast.public_context: Lyra normally controls every mechanism, but the observatory rejected her keys.
cast.private_context: Lyra knows that the alignment can open an erased gate.

actor_runtime.reveal_policy: Share warnings before theories; reveal the erased gate only when its risk becomes immediately relevant.

scenes.title: The powerless orrery
scenes.objective: Establish what each person knows and why they disagree.

scenes.title: The rewritten ledger
scenes.objective: Discover that the observatory changed its own records.

state_visibility.note: The control planner may reason about it; only Rowan may narrate from it before revelation.
